content.title: How to watch UConn vs. UCLA with Sling TV
content.text: #2 UConn and #7 UCLA clash at the Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia for an East Region second-round showdown. Here are details, our prediction, and how to watch with Sling TV.The No. 2 seed UConn Huskies (30-5) begin the second round of March Madness® as a formidable title contender after an 82-71 opening-round victory over Furman. Under head coach Dan Hurley, the Huskies are seeking their third national championship in four years, currently ranking in the top 10 nationally in both NET and KenPom ratings.They face a No. 7 seed UCLA Bruins (24-11) squad that advanced with a convincing 75-71 win over UCF. Led by coach Mick Cronin, the Bruins have shown defensive grit and efficient scoring, moving into the second round despite playing their opening game without key starter Tyler Bilodeau.UConn features a dominant interior presence in center Tarris Reed Jr., while UCLA counters with a top-20 three-point shooting attack and the playmaking of star guard Donovan Dent.To watch the Huskies vs. Bruins Second Round game with Sling, use the link below for a 1 Day Pass + Entertainment Extras subscription to TNT, or a monthly subscription to Sling Blue.UConn Huskies Analysis Season Overview: UConn (30-5) enters the second round as a heavy favorite to reach the Sweet 16. They are a statistical powerhouse, ranking 10th in KenPom and 10th in NET. They controlled their first-round game through interior dominance, holding Furman to 45.9% shooting inside the arc. Star Player: Tarris Reed Jr. (C). The standout center delivered a "heroic" performance in the first round, recording 31 points and 27 rebounds, more than the entire Furman team. He is the primary anchor for a Huskies team that ranks among the best in the nation in offensive rebounding rate (36.1%). The X-Factor: Proximity to Home. Playing in Philadelphia, the Huskies are just a short trip from Storrs. With a fanbase that travels exceptionally well, UConn is expected to have a significant home-court advantage at Xfinity Mobile Arena. UCLA Bruins Analysis Season Overview: UCLA (24-11) has navigated a challenging Big Ten schedule to reach the Round of 32. They are an elite shooting team, ranking in the top 20 nationally in three-point percentage (37.9%), a weapon they will need to utilize to stretch UConn's physical defense. Star Player: Donovan Dent (G). While hampered by a recent injury, Dent remains the heart of the Bruins' offense, averaging 7.6 assists per game. His health and ability to create shots against UConn's perimeter pressure will be critical for UCLA's upset hopes. The Upset Formula: Turnover Chaos. UCLA forces turnovers on 18.2% of possessions. If they can disrupt UConn’s offensive flow—which has seen a spike in turnover rate since February—the Bruins can limit the Huskies' possessions and keep the game close through the final minutes. Key Matchup & Advanced Analytics Position Battle: Interior Dominance vs. Perimeter Shooting. UConn’s Tarris Reed Jr. will test a UCLA frontcourt that may be without Tyler Bilodeau, while the Bruins will attempt to use their superior three-point shooting to bridge the talent gap. Statistical Edge: UConn holds a massive advantage in rebounding margin (+3.9) and quad-1 wins (6-1). However, UCLA enters with a higher free-throw percentage (76.7% vs. 71.6%), which could prove vital in a late-game situation. Betting Trends: UConn opened as a 4.5-point favorite. While the Huskies have been a tournament juggernaut under Hurley, UCLA has covered the spread in 7 of their last 9 games, making them a trendy pick to keep the score within two possessions. Final Prediction & Betting Pick The Verdict: UConn Huskies. Final Score Prediction: UConn 74, UCLA 70. Best Bet: UCLA +4.5. Frequently Asked Questions Who is the favorite in the game between Huskies and Bruins? UConn is a 3.5 to 4.5-point favorite according to opening lines from DraftKings and VSiN. What time is the UConn game? Tip-off is scheduled for 8:45 PM ET on Sunday at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia.
